annotation.title_clean: Joint Factsheet by the Land Transport Authority (LTA) & SSC - Enhanced National Standards for the Safe Deployment of Autonomous Vehicles in Singapore
annotation.title_en: Joint Factsheet by the Land Transport Authority (LTA) & SSC - Enhanced National Standards for the Safe Deployment of Autonomous Vehicles in Singapore
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Land Transport Authority (LTA); Singapore Standards Council (SSC)
annotation.summary_en: Joint LTA and Singapore Standards Council factsheet announcing the revised Technical Reference 68, Singapore's provisional national standard for safe deployment of SAE Level 4/5 autonomous vehicles. Revisions add machine learning, software updates, cybersecurity assessment and data formats, and align with ISO work.
key_provisions_or_claims: TR 68 revised March 2020–July 2021 by four industry-led working groups under the Singapore Standards Council.
Part 2 adds guidance for AI/ML use in AV systems and fault-response rules.
Part 3 strengthens security-by-design and requires independent third-party cybersecurity assessment.
Part 1 updates AV behaviour toward other road users, manoeuvres and special situations.
TR 68 informs ISO 37181 and is a voluntary provisional standard accessed by over 200 enterprises.
